lines.hook: What if World War Three started... tomorrow morning?
lines.intro: No movie explosions. Just what would actually change for a normal person like you, step by step.
lines.relate: You know that feeling when your phone buzzes with breaking news, and your stomach drops? Imagine that, on every channel, all at once.
lines.day1: Day one. Every phone buzzes with emergency alerts. People rush to the stores for water and batteries. Everyone is glued to the news.
lines.markets: Then the markets crash. Stock prices drop in minutes, and savings suddenly look a lot smaller.
lines.day3: Day three. Fuel prices jump. When war hit Ukraine in 2022, oil shot up to almost a hundred and forty dollars a barrel. Food prices follow.
lines.cyber: Next come cyberattacks. Hackers go after banks, power grids and airports. Flights get cancelled, and websites go dark.
lines.twist: But here's the crazy part. Since 1945, no two nuclear powers have ever fought a full scale war against each other. Why? Because a full war would be a loss for everyone. It's called deterrence.
lines.real: So could this really happen? In 2024, the world spent a record two point seven trillion dollars on militaries. And there are still about twelve thousand nuclear warheads.
lines.end: But most wars don't end with one final battle. They end with leaders sitting at a table, talking. Diplomacy is slow, but it works.
lines.cta: So be honest... what's the first thing you would do? Tell me in the comments.
